statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with a recent transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The patient has a concurrent diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I34.0 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The service was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias
